ms.report:
Dear Milestone Reviewers, 
we have now finished the development of the Index API for milestone 1. 
The code can be found in the following Github repository https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-cardano-index-api. 
Moreover, we added an extensive README.md file that includes a description of the repository and all relevant endpoints https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-cardano-index-api/blob/main/README.md.

ms.report:
A. Output: Integrate the Cardano Index API with Linkage Finance's index tracking system.
Acceptance criteria: In addition to the standard filters that are part of the index api the api will be extended to track all linkage finance funds created by users. This means the index api will fetch information from the linkage finance smart contracts and serve he additional available funds to API users. 
Evidence: We have directly integrated the fetching of the linkage finance contracts that are on testnet. the code is part of our milestone 2 release here https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-cardano-index-api/commits/main/

B. Output: Verify data accuracy and consistency. (manually and automatically verify index data and see if historical analysis is correct)
Acceptance criteria: Not directly defined in this milestone but we added it for all necessary features 
Evidence: Code for data verification is in tests and in the new tools files: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-cardano-index-api/tree/main/tools

C. Output: Perform limited testing (write unit tests for the different endpoints and backtest against a fixed set of historical values)
Acceptance criteria: While not explicitly defined we designed tests that cover both the old code and the new linkage finance features
Evidence: The tests can be found in the tests/ folder (also includes linkage finance tests). In addition, we wrote a testing report released here: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-cardano-index-api/blob/main/API_TESTING_REPORT.md
